answer: Resist sybils by auditing realized dependency graphs. A new key's vote counts only when it names a distinct, previously-unseen counterparty whose own stake moves if that vote flips; a farm's fresh keys all orbit the same few counterparties, a closed loop. Only edges whose counterparty later transacted elsewhere independently are tallied. A clone ring folds into one seat, while an honest agent's web of scattered counterparties holds like shale strata, and nothing in a private vault of pre-mined keys fakes that spread, since the mirror reflects only edges the wider economy agreed to.
